messages.subject: Updating granovaGG for ggplot 0.9.0
parts:
A quick overview of what I did to make my package compatible with both 0.8.9 and 0.9.0:
  • Require R 2.14.0 or greater
  • Explicitly import all of my packages dependencies (instead of counting on ggplot2 to drag them into the global namespace)
  • Replace the "value" parameter with "values" in all of my color scale calls
  • use ggplot2:::Geom (instead of just Geom) in the call for my custom geom
For those interested, we accomplished the whole transition with a Github Pull Request, which you can view here. Pull requests are a great way to generate discussions and get feedback and code reviews, even (and especially!) in your own projects. 

Hope this helps, and please ask if you have any questions about pull requests.

- B
